<button aria-label="Delete item" class="delete-button">
  <svg
    class="trash-svg"
    viewBox="0 -10 64 74"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
  >
    <g id="trash-can">
      <rect
        x="16"
        y="24"
        width="32"
        height="30"
        rx="3"
        ry="3"
        fill="#e74c3c"
      ></rect>

      <g transform-origin="12 18" id="lid-group">
        <rect
          x="12"
          y="12"
          width="40"
          height="6"
          rx="2"
          ry="2"
          fill="#c0392b"
        ></rect>
        <rect
          x="26"
          y="8"
          width="12"
          height="4"
          rx="2"
          ry="2"
          fill="#c0392b"
        ></rect>
      </g>
    </g>
  </svg>
</button>
